name: Gothic Killer
source:
London, 19th century. 

In the gaslight East End of the city, someone is murdering prostitutes. 
Newspapers have dubbed the killer "Jack the Ripper". 

In the course of his investigations a Scotland Yard detective meets a young blonde girl who brandishes a shortblade. 

Inspired by the true legend of the serial killer, with a fictionalized alternative conclusion. 
Also includes the Curse of the Hope Diamond and the murders of Sweeney Todd. 

from DLsite english: https://www.dlsite.com/eng/work/=/product_id/RE099866.html
translation:
伦敦，十九世纪。

在城市东区的煤气灯下，有人正在谋杀妓女。
报纸将凶手称为“开膛手杰克”。

在调查过程中，一名苏格兰场侦探遇到了一名挥舞着短刃的年轻金发女孩。

灵感源自连环杀手的真实传奇，并带有虚构的另类结局。
还包括希望钻石的诅咒和理发师托德的谋杀案。
